license: MIT; retained notice required for copied code
source_action_model: Two separate binary receive/send networks, shared across depth, rather than verified unrestricted4-way categorical policy.
source_sampling: F.gumbel_softmax hard=True at every training and evaluation forward; fresh single draw per role.
source_ST: hard-soft.detach()+soft; soft surrogate backward, not discrete derivative or unbiased policy gradient.
source_temperature: Shared node-dependent reciprocal softplus temperature; positive scalar temperature affects ideal ST softness but not hard argmax sample distribution.
source_mean_normalization: Fixed listed-edge count including zero-gated messages; not surviving/gate-sum normalization.
source_empty_row: Zero neighbor aggregate plus learned own-state route; source inference not executed fixture.
source_runner_limit: TEST evaluated everyepoch; eval loss full supplied targets while metric masked; best metrics retained without saved best weights; eval sampling stays stochastic.
proposed_polynormer_port: Post-native-softmax external-value gate receive(destination)*send(source); native self-loop message gate1 and root linear retained; no surviving-row renormalization.
proposed_serving: One predeclared fixed Gumbel-noise panel per member/layer, independent of labels and reused for selection/replay; explicit adaptation from fresh author eval draws, no draw selection.

native_regression.target: Mean5-feature vector of degree6 hub neighbors

graph_attribution_control: Frozen same-attention-mass uniform external damping versus source-selective gates; no additional fitting grid.
